label: Updated at 8 a.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Clark leads BMW Championship
items.text: Wyndham Clark rallied by birdying the final three holes to win the BMW Championship by three shots over Rory McIlroy, securing momentum for the Tour Championship.

items.headline: La Sasso youngest LIV leader
items.text: Michael La Sasso, 22, held off Jon Rahm by one shot for the LIV Golf Indianapolis victory, becoming LIV’s youngest-ever leader as the league ends its 2026 season early.

items.headline: Scheffler battled illness at BMW
items.text: Scottie Scheffler revealed he played the BMW Championship while suffering from hand, foot and mouth disease, finishing tied for 10th despite painful blisters.
